summary: Version 1 of the TikZ figure compiles and passes topology (missing_edges empty). It draws the parallelogram-like figure with A, B, C, D and E (E on AD), with edges AB, BC, CD, AD (as A-E-D), CE and BE. The Critic scored it 0.93 with must_repair=false. A follow-up inspection of the crop found no square right-angle mark at E, so none is drawn, and no letter J near the top, so the stray J label is omitted.
